root_cause: Canonical source provenance requires retained source.git_revision commits. Full checkout fetch retrieves reachable refs/history; a reviewed intermediate PR commit became unreachable from fetched branches after squash merge/deletion. The fresh official-origin clone lacks exactly6647fd6, though long-lived local objects made earlier checks pass. This is environment preparation, not an invalid review or a reason to weaken provenance.
preservation: No immutable review, validator, maintained data or HEAD changed. Full isolated clone has no alternates, shallow metadata or partial-clone filtering. Only a local refs/record-reviews/fullSHA retention ref was added.

existing_mechanism_search.result: No existing restore/fetch implementation found within infrastructure scope; governed docs require available Git provenance and trusted event base but supply no automatic restoration.

recommended_owner_change.workflow: Explicit preparation step after dependencies and before Test in .github/workflows/main.yaml; preserve trusted RECORD_REVIEW_BASE logic.
recommended_owner_change.local: Document explicit helper before local canonical review/test gates when a fresh clone lacks historical revisions; do not insert implicit network access into canonical validator.
algorithm: Use governed review_paths/read_bytes/parse_review_bundle to validate every immutable pair and expected repository identity without requiring source commit presence.
Validate every declared revision before any network fetch. For this SHA1 repository require exact lowercase40hex; never use branch names, expressions or caller-provided URLs.
Only missing revisions are fetched, noninteractively from the validated official origin using argument lists; disable tags/submodules/FETCH_HEAD overwrite.
Require raw object type commit and exact requested SHA; a tag that peels to a commit does not satisfy a pinned commit.
Keep refs/record-reviews/SHA locally to avoid GC; reject conflicting existing retention refs rather than force-overwrite. Preserve HEAD, branch/worktree and tracked bytes.
All malformed pairs/revisions, unavailable origins, fetch failures and wrong returned object types are terminal errors. Run unchanged canonical gate afterward.
regressions: Isolated bare-remote fixture retains a squashed review commit behind an unfetched PR ref; fresh nonshared clone starts missing it, exact fetch restores canonical consumer while bytes remain unchanged.
All-pair validation first: malformed SHA/expression or invalid canonical bundle triggers zero fetch attempts.
Unknown exact SHA/transport failure fails closed and does not report success or rewrite review inputs.
Blob/tag object IDs fail raw commit-type/exact-ID guard; conflicting retention ref cannot be overwritten.
Already available valid commits require no fetch; rerun is idempotent.
Wrong official origin/repository identity rejected; workflow test checks explicit preparation precedes canonical consumer.

limits: This verifies actual current GitHub retrieval of the exact pinned revision; it does not guarantee indefinite upstream retention. If upstream cannot provide the exact object, fail closed and recover that original object from trusted retained history, never rewrite the review base.
Root implementation remains independently reviewable; this receipt verifies the approach and fresh-clone behavior, not yet its code.
Only the single failed canonical consumer was rerun; no redundant full suite.
